Date 2026-10-26. **Author-level algebraic proof + exact rational computation**; independent Research Driver review and native frozen Result remain pending. This is an external finite two-measure decision model, **not** a P000/X6/Heartbeat dynamics theorem.

## Model

Two strictly positive probability laws P,Q on an ordered finite depth-two tree, with possible root stop. The finite set H of first-step raw histories has q_h=Q(h)>0, p_h=P(h)>0, l_h=p_h/q_h, and sum q_h=sum p_h=1. At each h, the terminal exact likelihood ratio R(h,y)=P(h,y)/Q(h,y) satisfies E_Q[R|h]=l_h. Policies may stop and declare P/Q at depths 0,1, and at depth 2 must declare; randomization is independent of the true law. The compressed policy sees only the time-indexed exact LR, T1=l_h and T2=R, not raw branch identity.

Four observations: O(pi)=(eP,eQ,tP,tQ)=(P[declare Q],Q[declare P],E_P tau,E_Q tau). Universal sufficiency means for every full-history randomized pi there exists a time/LR-only randomized beta with **all four** entries equal. No fine-flow, hidden-port, all-horizon or native physical equivalence is claimed.

Write H_l={h:l_h=l}. Let mu_h denote the conditional Q-law of terminal exact LR R at h. The first-level statistic is strongly LR-lumpable precisely when mu_h=mu_k for every h,k sharing the same l. This also guarantees equal P-conditional terminal LR laws because P(R=r|h)=(r/l)Q(R=r|h).

## Theorem A: any nonunit first LR unmasks unit-fiber heterogeneity

**Assume there exists a first history g with l_g != 1. Then universal four-scalar time/LR sufficiency, with root stopping permitted, holds IF AND ONLY IF every first-LR fiber has identical conditional terminal LR laws mu_h.**

Thus the exceptional masking possible when **all** first LRs are 1 disappears in the presence of any nonunit first LR. Notably, the other nonunit fibers may themselves be perfectly lumpable.

### Exact Bellman support envelope (arbitrary signed coefficients)

For any real A,B,C,D minimize J=A*eP+B*eQ+C*tP+D*tQ. Define

- H(r)=min(A*r,B) (terminal optimal error cost in Q-mass units);
- m_l=H(l) (optimal immediate first-node declaration);
- f_h=E_Q[H(R)|h] (optimal terminal cost after one more sample);
- c_l=C*l+D (incremental sampling cost in Q-mass units);
- Q_l=sum_{h in H_l}q_h, fbar_l=(sum_{h in H_l}q_h*f_h)/Q_l.

The full-history and LR-only exact Bellman minima are, including root immediate stop,

V_full(J)=min(H(1), C+D+sum_h q_h*min(m_{l_h},c_{l_h}+f_h)),

V_LR(J)=min(H(1), C+D+sum_l Q_l*min(m_l,c_l+fbar_l)).

These formulas handle signed coefficients, all root/terminal cases and randomized policies. Denote their second arguments S_full and S_LR. The strict global separation condition is exactly S_full<S_LR AND S_full<H(1).

Put d_h=m_l-f_h in each fiber. Conditional Jensen gives d_h>=0 when A=1, B=theta>0 (the only case needed for necessity). Since min(m_l,c_l+f_h)=m_l+min(0,c_l-d_h), Jensen's equality test shows S_full<S_LR if and only if some fiber has
min_{h in H_l} d_h < c_l < max_{h in H_l} d_h.
All q_h are strictly positive, hence a strict preference on both sides gives a strict gap; ties at the extreme do not.

The time/LR attainable observation set is a compact convex polytope contained in the full-history polytope: finite-horizon randomized behavioral strategies have realization-equivalent mixtures of finitely many deterministic legal action tables. Thus equal Bellman infima for all signed J imply full policy-by-policy four-scalar sufficiency by strict finite-dimensional separation, and a single strict signed-J separation disproves it.

### Necessity

Suppose h,k share first LR l but mu_h != mu_k. Let F_h(theta)=E_Q[min(R,theta)|h], theta>0. This family uniquely determines the finite conditional distribution of R: its right derivative between support atoms is Q(R>theta|h), with jumps identifying all masses. There is therefore theta>0 for which F_h(theta)!=F_k(theta). Define d_h=min(l,theta)-F_h(theta) and d_k likewise. Both are nonnegative by conditional Jensen, but unequal. Choose gamma_l strictly between d_h and d_k.

For J=eP+theta*eQ+C*tP+D*tQ, the action at first history h continues precisely if d_h > C*l+D, and stops if d_h < C*l+D. Set C*l+D=gamma_l. Histories h,k have opposite **strict** optimal actions, yielding a strictly positive within-fiber gap between full-history and LR-only Bellman continuations. Terminal optimal decisions depend only on exact R, so hidden terminal actions cannot erase this gap.

We now force root continuation without altering the fiber gap.

**Case l != 1:** independently prescribe gamma_0=C+D<0, and solve C*l+D=gamma_l, C+D=gamma_0. This has a unique solution because l!=1. At the root, continuing and stopping at every first state costs at most gamma_0+sum_h q_h min(l_h,theta) <= gamma_0+min(1,theta)<min(1,theta), by Jensen. Root continuation is therefore strictly optimal in both classes. The strict fiber gap persists.

**Case l = 1:** now C+D=gamma_l>0 (d's are nonnegative). Use the theorem's nonunit first history g with l_g!=1. Let C tend to +infinity if l_g<1, or to -infinity if l_g>1; set D=gamma_l-C. The unit fiber continues to have c_1=gamma_l, so its strict gap is unchanged. But c_{l_g}=gamma_l+C(l_g-1) tends to -infinity. The root continuation value includes the positive-Q-mass contribution q_g*min(m_{l_g},c_{l_g}+f_g), tending to -infinity; every other first-state minimum is bounded above by its finite stop loss. The corresponding LR-compressed first-fiber contribution at l_g likewise tends to -infinity. Thus for a sufficiently large **finite** choice of |C| the root strictly continues in both classes, while the unit-fiber gap remains strictly positive.

In either case V_full(J)<V_LR(J). Take a full-history Bellman minimizer; its four-vector cannot be attained by any time/LR-only policy. Contradiction to universal sufficiency. Hence mu_h is constant on every first-LR fiber. QED necessity.

### Sufficiency (explicit observer-preserving Markovization)

Assume all first-LR fibers are strongly lumpable. Fix any full randomized policy. Preserve its root action distribution. At first LR l replace the various hidden-history stop-P, stop-Q and continue probabilities by their Q-weighted averages, weights q_h/Q_l. Their P-weighted averages coincide because p_h=l*q_h throughout the fiber, so both measures preserve first decision masses and continuation masses.

By the common terminal kernel mu_l, the incoming terminal Q mass for exact terminal LR r from fiber l is exactly its aggregated Q continuation mass multiplied by mu_l(r), regardless of which hidden histories continued. The corresponding P mass is r times that Q mass. Across all incoming branches of terminal LR r choose the compressed terminal declare-P probability to equal the original Q mass that declares P divided by total incoming Q mass (arbitrary at an unreachable terminal state). P declaration masses are then also preserved at fixed r. Therefore both error probabilities and both expected sample sizes agree exactly. This constructs the desired time/LR behavioral policy. QED sufficiency.

## Corollary: complete N=2 root-allowed classification

Combine new Theorem A with the precisely scoped previous all-unit theorem in PROOF_LR_ROOT_MASKING_N2.md:

1. If at least one l_h differs from 1, universal four-scalar LR sufficiency holds **iff** all conditional terminal LR laws agree within every first LR fiber.
2. If every l_h=1, define D_h(theta)=min(1,theta)-E_Q[min(R,theta)|h], Dbar(theta)=sum_h q_h D_h(theta). Universal sufficiency holds **iff** Dbar(theta)<=2*min_h D_h(theta) for all theta>0 (inherited all-unit root-masking theorem).

The second case can have nonlumpable yet four-scalar-sufficient LR states. The first case cannot. In both, conclusions are finite N=2 and observer-scoped.

## Eight-leaf exact counterexample to mixed-fiber masking

First histories h=a,b,c,d have:

| h | Q(h) | P(h) | first LR | Q(x,y|h) | P(x,y|h) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| a | 1/8 | 1/8 | 1 | (1/2,1/2) | (3/4,1/4) |
| b | 1/8 | 1/8 | 1 | (1/2,1/2) | (1/2,1/2) |
| c | 1/4 | 1/2 | 2 | (1/2,1/2) | (1/2,1/2) |
| d | 1/2 | 1/4 | 1/2 | (1/2,1/2) | (1/2,1/2) |

All eight leaves under each hypothesis are strictly positive; total masses are 1. Their exact terminal LR pairs are a:(3/2,1/2), b:(1,1), c:(2,2), d:(1/2,1/2). The **only nonlumpable fiber** is the unit first-LR pair (a,b). Nonunit fibers c and d are singletons.

Choose the simple objective J=eP+eQ+(1/8)tQ (A=B=1, C=0, D=1/8), with **nonnegative sampling costs**. For a,b,c,d respectively, the first-step immediate stop losses m_h are (1,1,1,1/2), the optimal terminal expected losses f_h are (3/4,1,1,1/2), and continuation losses 1/8+f_h are (7/8,9/8,9/8,5/8). Full-history optimal action: at a continue; at b,c stop P; at d stop Q.

Exact Bellman minimization gives V_full=55/64. At the compressed first LR=1, pooling a,b makes stop and continue cost **both** 1, so LR-only minimum V_LR=7/8=56/64. Root immediate stop cost is 1. Strict J gap is 1/64.

An explicit full optimal policy continues at root, continues at a, then declares P after a:x and Q after a:y; stops P at b,c and Q at d. It has

O(pi)=(9/32,7/16,9/8,9/8), J(pi)=55/64.

No randomized time/LR-only strategy can reproduce these four numbers because every such policy has J>=7/8. Even ordinary nonnegative time cost suffices to unmask this example; the general theorem's signed costs are used to prove necessity for **all** possible mixed models.

## Exact computation, coverage and method

Actually executed Python standard-library fractions.Fraction verifier: VERIFY_MIXED_LR.py. It checked positivity, exact mass normalizations, first and terminal LR labels, both exact Bellman optima, the full-history four-vector and 1/64 gap. Independently enumerated all **1296** deterministic LR-only action tables (3 root * 3^3 first-LR * 2^4 terminal-LR) and all **62208** deterministic full-history action tables (3 root * 3^4 first-raw-history * 2^8 terminal-raw-history). Exact minima: LR 7/8, full 55/64. Printed run evidence in EXACT_CHECK_OUTPUT.txt. These finite exhaustive checks validate only the rational witness; the general theorem is the algebra above. No floating-point or statistical inference.

BRC method resolution: REUSE_APPLIED (ordered positive rational P/Q branch masses; observer-specific safe quotient and exact fiber defect). Retained raw branch provenance before quotient. The support-gap 1/64 detects an observer-specific lost predictive relation; signed *differences* of flows are not signed BRC amplitudes. No claim of executing a native BRC program or mapping this auxiliary tree to P000/X6/Heartbeat.

Scientific status: AUTHOR_PROVED_THEOREM_A / FINITE_RATIONAL_CHECK_PASS / INDEPENDENT_DRIVER_UNREVIEWED / NATIVE_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED. No Working Truth or Foundation promotion.
